extraction_notes: Main-text performance data were digitised from Figure 5a only. Figure 5b was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot (ln rate vs 1/T). Other main-text figures are characterisation/reduction/spent-catalyst figures and do not report measured NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF. Experimental section reports 1 g catalyst, 90 bar, and 200 N mL min−1 total flow after activation; the gas feed is described as 75% H2/N2 and elsewhere as stoichiometric 3H2/N2. All plotted rates are approximate reads from the markers in Figure 5a and use the figure axis unit μmol gFe−1 s−1.
